summary: Abandoned L-4 ground cabin on the Challis National Forest, built 1935 and left by 1946; restored in the 1970s and registered in 2016.

facts.status_note: Abandoned as a lookout in 1946. The restored cabin still stands, per a 2022 Idaho Fire Lookouts post.

access.note: TopoZone says the lookout is open to the public. The Register's 2016 visit report describes a long walk up an ATV/UTV road. No closure is recorded in the sources read; TopoZone mentions a 50-inch gate but does not say it is closed. Provisional: rests mainly on one map site.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists it as hike-in. TopoZone describes a road about 3.5 miles long, climbing 2,500 feet, with a 50-inch gate, suitable only for high-clearance 4x4 vehicles, dirt bikes or hikers. The Register's visit report describes a long walk up an ATV/UTV road.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR, firelookout.com, the Forest Lookouts page and TopoZone give 1935. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1936. The story uses 1935 and reports the 1936 figure.
TopoZone says manned until 1943. NHLR, firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page date abandonment to 1946. The story reports both.
NHLR gives 9,556 ft (2,913 m). firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 9,546 ft. The story reports both figures.

Idaho Fire Lookouts calls it hike-in. TopoZone describes a 3.5-mile road suited to high-clearance 4x4 vehicles, dirt bikes and hikers. The Register visit report describes a long walk up an ATV/UTV road. The story reports the accounts without choosing one.

notes_for_editor: Access 'public' rests on one map site (TopoZone) plus the 2016 visit report; treat it as provisional and check with the Challis National Forest. Build year 1935 (four sources) vs 1936 (Idaho). Elevation 9,556 vs 9,546 ft. Staffing end 1943 (TopoZone) vs 1946 abandonment. Record coordinates match NHLR and TopoZone; the record's conflict note about Idaho Fire Lookouts coordinates (about 0.5 km off) is not visible in the pages read. Cabin is a ground cab, not a tower. No rental found.
